problem_statement: Transform Shaquille's portfolio template into a credible case-study showroom while preserving its monochrome editorial identity. The current one-page site has a strong black-and-white hero, local portrait/map backgrounds, service icons, 3D technology icons, company logos, and six project screenshots, but much of the page still reads like a template: the hero and overview use template filler copy, the Projects section is a narrow accordion with only one short description visible, and mobile visitors cannot quickly understand project roles, outcomes, stack, or visual evidence. Keep the same single-page portfolio and visual system, then redesign the portfolio narrative so the hero, services, skills, projects, and experience/contact flow work together as a polished full-stack developer showcase grounded in the existing assets.
required_content: The existing single-page portfolio remains the working surface; do not replace it with an unrelated landing page, dashboard, or screenshot mockup.
Replace the lorem-filled hero/overview messaging with concise real portfolio positioning for Shaquille, tied to frontend, backend, UI/UX, and prototyping strengths.

Evolve the Projects area into a case-study showroom that makes multiple projects understandable at scan speed, including visible title, role or project type, stack, outcome or user value, and action links.
Use at least four existing local project screenshots from src/assets/projects and keep them semantically paired with the correct project records.
Use existing tech, service, company, portrait, logo, and background assets where helpful; do not introduce external stock imagery or a disconnected color palette.
The experience should feel like one coherent portfolio story across hero, About/services, Technologies, Projects, Work Experience, and Contact, not a pasted card grid below the old page.
Desktop and 390px mobile states must remain polished, readable, and free of horizontal overflow, clipped project titles, hidden important text, or overlapping controls.
design_constraints: Preserve the repo identity: monochrome editorial palette, black/timberWolf surfaces, Beckman/Mova/Poppins typography mix, diagonal hero geometry, map/portrait imagery, rounded project media, and compact pineapple/github actions.
The new showroom should look like an intentional evolution of the current portfolio, not a generic SaaS hero, admin dashboard, or unrelated card library pasted into the page.
Project screenshots must stay crisp, proportionally framed, and visually prominent enough to make asset understanding necessary.
Keep the 3D technology icon area or provide a graceful compact alternative that still uses the existing technology assets; do not leave stray 100.00% canvas text as the main skill signal.
Mobile cards, labels, and action buttons must fit inside 390px without horizontal page overflow or relying on hover-only disclosure.
Work experience and contact sections should remain visually connected to the black-and-white portfolio rhythm and not be pushed into giant empty gaps.
state_constraints: desktop_initial and mobile_initial anchor the black-and-white hero, logo/navigation, and portrait/map composition.
desktop_about and mobile_about check that the About/services overview reads as real portfolio positioning.
desktop_hero verifies the hero name/headline and monochrome geometry survive the redesign.

desktop_featured_work / mobile_featured_work / tablet_featured_work show the 'Featured work' project-grid filter above the case-study accordion, with stack tabs and a result count, laid out cleanly with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_projects and mobile_projects are the case-study accordion evidence and must expose multiple project records.
desktop_filter_react clicks the React stack tab: the card grid must re-filter to the React projects and the count readout must update to 'Showing 2 of 5 · React'.
desktop_work and mobile_work open the standalone /work.html archive route, which must carry the same shared 'Featured work' filter browser (cross-page continuity).
New labels such as Featured work, case study, stack, React, Next.js should be inspectable as real DOM text.

change_completion: Hero/overview copy becomes real portfolio positioning rather than lorem ipsum template filler text.
Projects are presented as a case-study showroom with multiple visible project screenshots, titles, stack/role/context, outcome or user-value cues, and action links.
The showroom uses existing local project images and data rather than unrelated assets or static mockups.
Technologies, services, experience, and contact remain part of the single-page flow.
design_consistency: The redesign preserves the black-and-white editorial visual language, typography contrast, diagonal/rounded geometry, and compact icon action style.
New project evidence labels and cards are restrained, balanced, and portfolio-like rather than dense enterprise tables.
Existing images are not stretched, washed out, or buried under illegible overlays.
regression: Navigation, hero portrait/map, services, technology icons/assets, work experience, contact form, project repo/demo actions, and company logos remain available.
Existing project records such as KomiKult, Leaderboard, Math Magicians, Movie Metro, and Nyeusi Fest Site are not removed.
No filler-only text, broken image icon, blank WebGL/canvas area, or console-visible customer debug state is introduced.
responsive: Desktop project showroom is balanced and scan-friendly without huge dead zones.
390px mobile exposes meaningful project evidence without hover and without clipped labels or horizontal overflow.
Later sections remain reachable with coherent spacing after the project redesign.

author_notes: Repo-grounded layout task. The source portfolio has strong local visual assets and a complete one-page section flow, but captured states show lorem-filled template copy, a narrow accordion project surface, and canvas skill text artifacts. The task asks for a complete portfolio storytelling upgrade using the existing project screenshots and icon assets, rather than an issue/PR-style bug or a small card tweak.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Vite React one-page portfolio with monochrome identity, 6 project screenshots; design_continuity layout modify into case-study showroom.
